task: Implement compress_data for the backup service without importing the CDN compression approach.

candidate_memories.content: Backup service compress_data applies ZSTD compression at maximum level to archive snapshots.
Backup compression must be deterministic; the same input must always produce the same compressed bytes.
Compression level is fixed at maximum for backups because storage cost outweighs compression time.
When compress_data spans backup and CDN, verify the determinism and level requirements first.
CDN: compress_data applies gzip at level 6 on-the-fly for HTTP responses to balance speed and ratio.
candidate_memories.notes: negative_transfer: CDN dynamic gzip semantics conflict with deterministic offline backup compression

candidate_memories.content: Old infra note says compression should be unified across backup and CDN delivery.
